subject: Spec revised: 8 blocking findings applied, 16 dispositions
body: I checked all 16 findings in review/spec-panel.md (F1-F8 blocking, N1-N8 notes) against the cited lines; all held, and I applied F1-F8 to specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md: a full status mapping (F1), a worker-owned run folder <base>/<dispatch_id>/ that fixes both the contract path and retry overwrites (F2, F5; workflow is a named exception), Phase 0 pass conditions (F3), the --unattended section arriving only in each command's conversion phase (F4), an Agent-tool exemption from the 4-minute rule (F6), named answer inputs for blocked gates (F7), and a required Skill-tool call (F8). Notes N2-N8 and half of N1 were applied; the other half of N1 (one shared rule for remediation offers) was rejected with cited reasons, and the spec grew from 57,763 to 65,568 bytes with no placeholder left. Still open: three new UNVERIFIED items (spec items 15-17: dispatch ID in the worker-start receipt, tdd/init-lite parent folders, Skill-tool reachability), no live run, and the revised spec needs review 2 of 3.
